verdict.rationale: Babylon.js documents a dedicated glTF importer and lists glTF among its supported model formats alongside OBJ, STL and .babylon, so the glTF part of the story is covered first-party. The pack has no evidence of FBX or USD import, so only one of the three named formats is delivered. The 3ds Max/Maya/Blender exporter plugins are DCC-side export tools, not FBX/USD import, and earn no credit here. Missing for 10: FBX import, USD import, independent hands-on confirmation that glTF imports cleanly.
